denoising.isolation: Per-UV-chart with same-chart edge extension; subpixel charts excluded and reported

sourceNightLighting.meaning: Authored accepted source lighting, restored exactly for night except visitor lamp omitted. Positions/rotations use Blender coordinates; source socket colours are linear.

nativePreview.approval: Root accepted native bank mapping. Corrected evaluated-undeformed transfer leaves bank values/geometry/UV0/UV2/SurfaceTint unchanged; no second image required.

bake.cachePolicy: Full scene/source/material/image/lighting identity. Region chart equality reuses UV preparation only, never illumination.

hiddenUVAllocationProof.rule: Only whole connected tile components enclosed by an opaque closed roof-snow volume, all vertex/mid-edge/face-center samples at least20mm inside, and no BVH-overlap pairs with the snow boundary. Full render/bake geometry is retained; this only identifies potential UV allocation exclusions.

hall.coverageMeaning: World-space mapped surface-area weighted; proven enclosed geometry is reported separately. A represented chart may contain subpixel triangles; their native-texel area is also reported. Camera-visible sampled coverage is separate.
hall.scope: Coarse first-hit geometry visibility over the source reference cameras; excludes sky. Features smaller than the sampling grid and shading/noise quality are not verified by this metric.

materialRecipe.metadataSource: Actual GLB material/image bindings and embedded KTX2 DFD/header; codec and dimensions are not inferred from filenames.
